title: Event-triggered Control and Online Learning for Networked Systems under Computational Delays
abstract: arXiv:2608.29576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online learning-based control is a promising approach to control uncertain systems, where unknown components are identified during operation to improve control performance. However, resource-intensive online learning algorithms introduce non-negligible computational delays, especially when executed on systems with limited local computational resources. To mitigate this, an in-network online learning-based control structure is employed by deploying the learning-based controller on a remote computation node and connecting it via a communication channel. In this paper, control performance guarantee is first established by deriving tracking error bound for the in-network control architecture, while accounting for computational delays. The derived tracking error bound allows for diverse communication and computation strategies under a specific condition, including time-/event-triggered mechanisms. translated_title: 计算延迟下网络化系统的事件触发控制与在线学习
translated_abstract: 基于在线学习的控制是控制不确定系统的一种有前景的方法，其中未知组件在运行过程中被识别，以改善控制性能。然而，资源密集型的在线学习算法会引入不可忽视的计算延迟，尤其是在本地计算资源有限的系统上执行时。为缓解这一问题，本文采用了一种网内（in-network）基于在线学习的控制结构，将基于学习的控制器部署在远程计算节点上，并通过通信信道与之连接。本文首先通过推导该网内控制架构下的跟踪误差界，建立了控制性能保证，同时考虑了计算延迟的影响。所推导的跟踪误差界允许在特定条件下采用多样化的通信与计算策略，包括时间触发和事件触发机制。此外，本文还分析了通信与计算之间的权衡……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文针对在线学习控制中的计算延迟问题，提出了网内控制架构下的跟踪误差界保证，支持时间触发与事件触发等多样化的通信与计算策略。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes tracking error bounds for an in-network learning-based control architecture that accounts for computational delays, enabling diverse communication and computation strategies such as time- and event-triggered mechanisms.
